value: A mystic crystal responds to five skulls associated by the quest with Scourge that took part in the assault. Their collection is a gameplay task, so it cannot be read as a definitive list of every enemy or a complete battle roster. It adds another layer to Chromie’s reconstruction: selected remains, a remembered account, and relics tied to those who fought. The exact mechanism of the crystal is not explained beyond its use in the quest.
editorNote: Five skulls is the quest requirement, not an independently verified number of Scourge participants.
